note: The script asks for the hook text, two top question texts, one name super and the key words LIVE EVERY DAY, so 5 graphics and the end card. Every other row is captions only.

mg.title: Hook question
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “Are you happy?” Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until “Absolutely.” Top third.

mg.title: Question text

text.main: What is the source of your happiness?

mg.cue: Top text at 00:05, 2 s: “What is the source of your happiness?”
mg.use: Put it on at 00:05 and hold 2 s, in the top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:07 for 2.5 s, lower left above the captions: “Jacob Keyes” / Owner, Skydance Brewing Company.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:07 for 2.5 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <Owner, Skydance Brewing Company> under the name.

mg.title: Question text

text.main: One message to the entire world?

mg.cue: Top text at 00:27, 2 s: “One message to the entire world?”
mg.use: Put it on at 00:27 and hold 2 s, in the top band, before “it would be”. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Live every day
mg.cue: Key words one at a time, top third: LIVE EVERY DAY, in on “live”, out at the end of the line.
mg.use: Start it on the word “live” and let it run to the end of the line. Top band. Captions stay on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: NIWRC logo, white on NIWRC red #981C20. One line under it: NIWRC × Happy Productions.
mg.src: NIWRC logo (white) from NIWRC's onboarding brand file, in the brand kit 10 Oct 2026 (endcards/index.json). Client rule: white logo on red.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it right after “before.” and hold it to the end. Music fades out over 1 s.
